sourceTitle: The Decameron (Day 1 to Day 5) Containing an hundred pleasant Novels
description: "The Decameron (Day 1 to Day 5)" by Giovanni Boccaccio is a collection of short stories written between 1348 and 1353. Ten young people flee plague-ridden Florence to shelter in a secluded villa, where they pass time by telling tales.
